text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
What a crowd...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The stands of the Nakayama Racecourse
are
absolutely packed. Everyone can't
wait to see the
long-awaited Satsuki
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Of course! And didja hear that Biwa
Hayahide's
racing today? She's Narita
Brian's older sister!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Say, who was it that was in the magazine
again?
You know, the little cute one!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: You mean Нарита Таисин?
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I dunno about her. She's a little
too small.
Might have more of a fighting
chance if she was a
bit sturdier...
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, everybody says Уиннинг Тикит
and Biwa
Hayahide are in the top two!
Best keep an eye on
'em till the Derby, I
say!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: Yeah? I'll keep that in mind.
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Seriously? I wouldn't even be here if I
wasn't
"sturdy" enough. I'll show you who
the top two
are...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Clueless idiots!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Well... Here we are—the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll be up against Ticket and Taishin,
which
means...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Exactly. This is going to be a close
battle for sure.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But this is the first race of the Classic
Triple
Crown tour. I can't afford to lose.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
A loss here wipes out any chance of
being
considered the greatest of my
generation.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Then let's get out there and win!

text_block_list.text: You'd better believe I will!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I participated in the Asahi Hai
F.S. and
learned how to deal with my
nerves.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Time to head over to the paddock...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Step, step, stЭпизод..
Hm? That's...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Taishin? She looks unusually stiff.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, she won't be able to run at her
best if she's
all wound up like that. I
should talk with her and
help her relax.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(What happened to her? She looks
incredibly
fierce...)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The competitors are coming up to the
paddock!
Next up is...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Oh! It's already my turn. I'd better hurry!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
